description.p: Omarchy Notes is a native, local-first notes app inspired by Apple Notes. Open it, start typing, and your note is saved.

ul.li: Rich notes with headings, checklists, tables, images and file attachments
Folders, #tags, Smart Folders, pinning, and search as you type
Quick Note window and command-line capture
Import Markdown; export Markdown, HTML and PDF; full-library backups

description.p: It works offline with no account, keeps everything in a local SQLite library, and follows the active Omarchy theme.

screenshot.caption: A meeting note with checklists, a table, a chart and a PDF attachment
